tax.text: He opposed proposed New Jersey tax increases and called for more responsible spending instead.
tax.quote: Higher taxes are not the solution. New Jersey is already generating record revenue, yet the state government continues to overspend.

trade.text: He said the United States should expand rather than eliminate tariffs on Chinese goods.
trade.quote: The Biden Administration should be expanding tariffs on Chinese goods, not eliminating them.

debt.text: He said he would not support cuts to Medicare, Social Security, or Medicaid for eligible beneficiaries.
debt.quote: These programs are lifelines for our seniors, individuals with disabilities, and working families, and I will never support cuts to them.

safety.text: Called for local police to coordinate with ICE, DHS, and federal law enforcement to maintain order.
safety.quote: Local police must keep working with ICE, DHS, and federal law enforcement to maintain order.

immigration.text: He called for passage of the Secure the Border Act, which includes more border agents, tighter asylum standards, and ending catch and release.
immigration.quote: I will continue to call out the lack of action by Democrat leaders and fight to protect our citizens by returning to a nation of law and order.

guns.text: He opposed New Jersey gun-control proposals, saying they would punish legal gun owners.
guns.quote: This is not common-sense gun legislation, this is legislation that will make it tougher for law-abiding New Jerseyans to purchase a gun and will not stop criminals from committing gun violence.

abortion.text: He praised the Supreme Court’s decision overturning Roe v. Wade and said abortion laws should be made by the states.
abortion.quote: The Supreme Court made the right decision to return this issue to the states so they can create their own laws regarding abortion.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He introduced legislation opposing New Jersey school guidance allowing facility use according to gender identity.
gender.quote: we should not be compromising the safety of our young children by allowing restrooms and changing rooms be available to any child regardless of their actual gender.

cannabis.text: He voted against the MORE Act, which would have federally legalized and regulated marijuana.
cannabis.quote: Vote Question: On Passage MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

energy.text: He opposed offshore-wind projects, citing higher utility rates and costs to taxpayers.
energy.quote: I have been fighting against these projects for years because we knew from the start they would be a financial disaster for our state.

voting.text: He voted for the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act, which would require proof of citizenship to register for federal elections.
voting.quote: Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act Vote Type: Recorded Vote Status: Passed

immigration.text: He supports a compassionate process centered on a path to citizenship rather than detention centers.
immigration.quote: One that prioritizes a clear path to citizenship over detention centers.

tax.text: He proposes no income tax for people earning under $40,000 and says some programs would be funded by cutting military spending and increasing taxes on wealthy people.
tax.quote: Paid for by reducing military budgets by cutting fraudulent spending there; increasing taxes on the wealthy cheats; and increased tax collection from better paid careers without increasing tax rates.

housing.text: He proposes transitional housing and taxpayer-funded citizen-owned apartment units, with some proceeds reinvested in building more units.
housing.quote: This 10-20% profit would then be reinvested into building more units, or into the communities in which they serve to be able to improve the towns that host them.

safety.text: He calls for federal funding for community centers and youth projects as essential public services.
safety.quote: These NEED to be essential services because the Streets are recruiting for worse and we need to be recruiting for better

immigration.text: He proposes abolishing and replacing ICE and says people should be held responsible for their own offenses rather than targeted as a group.
immigration.quote: Whether it be immigrants, protests, white, black, POC, Trans, Gay or straight on any issue. We should punish offenders of crimes, not a collective.

abortion.text: He says abortion should remain a personal choice and opposes forcing that choice on others.
abortion.quote: Every woman, EVERY person, deserves to be able to have full autonomy over their own body full stop.

health.text: He supports government-quality health care for everyone and proposes getting rid of insurance companies.
health.quote: Government Employees like congress get the best healthcare in the country, and I believe that should be extended to every American.

energy.text: He proposes expanding the grid with solar, wind, water and nuclear options to reduce electric bills.
energy.quote: Expanding the grid with unique solar, wind, water, and nuclear solutions can reduce electric bills significantly.

voting.text: He proposes free documentation for voter ID requirements alongside expanded vote-by-mail and says his approach should improve access and ease of voting.
voting.quote: Republicans get what they want better ID based voting Democrats get what they want, easier voting process.
